name: Infra postgres module with self-hosted backups
description: Milestone 6. postgres.database/server/backup compose services, managed DigitalOcean databases (database_cluster.database, existing lookups). Backups only for self-hosted postgres (postgres.database run by postgres.server) to Spaces with bucket lifecycle retention; postgres.backup on a managed database fails validate (DigitalOcean backs those up). Restore is #42; copying data elsewhere is #50. See docs infra-cli/db-copy.
